totals.sourceTitle: Nova Scotia Budget 2026-27 - Defending Nova Scotia: Planning for the long term

departments.name: Advanced Education
departments.description: Funds universities and student financial assistance.

departments.name: Agriculture
departments.description: Supports farmers through funding programs, food safety, and agricultural research.

departments.name: Communities, Culture, Tourism and Heritage
departments.description: Funds museums, libraries, arts, tourism marketing, and heritage sites. Includes African Nova Scotian Affairs, Acadian Affairs and Gaelic Affairs.

departments.name: Cyber Security and Digital Solutions
departments.description: Runs the province's digital infrastructure and cybersecurity: the critical technology behind registries, government services, public data, and the broader economy.

departments.name: Debt Servicing Costs
departments.description: Interest payments on the province's outstanding debt.

departments.name: Education and Early Childhood Development
departments.description: Runs public schools, early learning and child care, and student support services.

departments.name: Emergency Management
departments.description: Coordinates emergency planning and response to wildfires, floods, and other disasters.

departments.name: Energy
departments.description: Regulates the energy sector and runs renewable energy and energy-efficiency programs.

departments.name: Environment and Climate Change
departments.description: Runs climate change programs, pollution monitoring, and environmental protection.

departments.name: Finance and Treasury Board
departments.description: Manages the province's budget, debt, and financial reporting.

departments.name: Fisheries and Aquaculture
departments.description: Supports the fisheries and aquaculture industries, including licensing programs.

departments.name: Growth and Development
departments.description: Improves productivity, advances strategic sectors and supports innovation, investment and exports. Expands housing supply, supporting affordability and access to home ownership.

departments.name: Health and Wellness
departments.description: Runs hospitals, primary care, mental health and addictions services, and drug programs across the province.

departments.name: Justice
departments.description: Runs the courts, correctional services, policing support, and legal aid.

departments.name: Labour, Skills and Immigration
departments.description: Delivers skills training, apprenticeships, immigration settlement programs and funding for Nova Scotia Community College

departments.name: Municipal Affairs
departments.description: Provides funding and oversight for towns, municipalities, and local governments.

departments.name: Natural Resources
departments.description: Manages forestry, mining, and parks on Crown land.

departments.name: Pension Valuation Adjustment
departments.description: An accounting adjustment reflecting changes in the value of the province's pension obligations.

departments.name: Corporate Offices
departments.description: Various Offices, such as the Auditor General, Elections Nova Scotia, Equity and Anti-Racism, and L'nu. Also labour negotiations, human resources, and other internal operations across government.

departments.name: Public Works
departments.description: Builds and maintains highways, bridges, and public infrastructure, including winter snow removal.

departments.name: Seniors and Long-term Care
departments.description: Funds long-term care homes, home care, and other supports for older Nova Scotians.

departments.name: Service Nova Scotia
departments.description: Includes everyday public-facing services such as drivers licences, birth/death certificates, permits, the provincial archives and freedom of information requests.

departments.name: Opportunities and Social Development
departments.description: Delivers income assistance, disability supports including the Human Rights Remedy (this amount is protected), and community social services, including supports for homelessness.

departments.name: Refundable Tax Credits
departments.description: Tax credits paid out directly to individuals and businesses, such as the Affordable Living Tax Credit.
